appearance.identity: Earth-tone circular calabash, white undulating roof with elongated opening, inclined supports, orange three-tier bowl and western hospitality band.
appearance.master: Original detailed panel/roof/bowl source and its hash retained unchanged.
appearance.browser: Independent four-level calabash/roof/bowl derivatives preserve mapped plan, color ranks, true short panel openings and primary supports. Near tiers retain facade ribs, triangular roof ring, pitch markings and goal frames.
appearance.exclusions: Exact panel inventory, spectator/seat count, fine roof joints, full event fixtures and enclosed hospitality interiors are not claimed.

nativeAxes.origin: Mapped pitch center; +Z follows its southward axis. Field and structural foot datum are native Y0; the photographed access podium rises above it.

sourceFacts.basis: ExactQ163521 OSM envelope and separate roof/field polygons determine the plan and orientation. Roof designer sbp gives40m above field, roughly300m diameter,36m cantilever and800m triangular ring. Fabrication analyst EnginSoft records three0.71–0.91m tubular ring chords,28support locations including12shafts,60cantilevers and120facade sectors. The GFRC supplier case study records1.2x1.8m,13mm panels in8colors; its60m overall summary conflicts with the roof designer’s40m above-field datum, so the engineering datum governs this model. Five full-resolution sbp construction/completed photos were inspected for curvature, glazing strips, panel openings and roof corrugation. Panel mosaic and smaller connection positions are reconstructed, not an inventory claim.

geographic.groundContactBasis: The inspected exterior picture supports the broad rounded calabash, earth-tone mosaic, white undulating roof and inclined feet. Retained stadium/roof/pitch loops and western hospitality band set approximate scale and signed heading. Standard viewer PMTiles working datum 1696.3178584257548m contains high samples under the stadium. The existing reversible ground opening follows only the stadium/podium footprint and preserves surrounding raw PMTiles. The model supplies its own level pitch/apron and bounded podium; browser outer skirt toes meet surrounding sampled terrain. Field/floor and grade remain reconstructed, not surveyed.

Original detailed master/hash/recipe preserved. Browser derivatives retain calabash, roof/opening, three-tier bowl, supports and western hospitality asymmetry; mosaic colors, panel windows, row impressions and joints are interpreted.

The existing reversible ground opening suppresses coarse terrain only within the stadium/podium footprint. Raw surrounding PMTiles are retained and restore on unload. Bounded pitch/apron and podium are model architecture, not broad duplicated landscape.

Three shared concrete/painted-metal/membrane graphs plus explicit seat/glass/turf colors; zero embedded images. Full fixture/seat inventory, interiors, collision and physical-device timing excluded. Footprint replacement remains off.
